notes: Written for eu-01-b's and eu-01-c's request (a Chalcidian League dossier). Neither page gives an area or a city list, so the shapes are readings: the Chalcidice, plus a Pella disc (385) and the Thermaic coast for 'most of the Greek cities west of the Strymon' by 382. The pages disagree on dates: foundation 432 (body) or 'around 430' (lead); the Spartan campaign 382 (Olynthus page) or appeal 383 and war 383-379 (League page). Undated: the alliance with Athens (the League 'joined the Second Athenian League, then fought Athens over Amphipolis and lost Torone and Potidaea'), the expansion to 34 cities in the alliance with Philip II; these are not drawn. Philip's dealings with Pella, Amphipolis and Potidaea are not on these pages. Gazetteer names used that it lacks: Chalcidice (region). Repair of 2026-10-19 (reviewer verdict fail): the League page has Amyntas's 393/2 transfer 'temporary' and 'restored when Amyntas regained power' (-391 here, from the Amyntas III page), and Pella only with the second transfer 'eight years later' (-385, computed), so Pella is no longer drawn from 393 or after 375. The land beyond Pella and the 393/2 land are not named on any page (placeholders: a Thessaloniki disc of 25 km for 393/2, one of 40 km for the Thermaic cities of 382). At the dissolution of 379 the cities outside the Chalcidic peninsula are freed (loss to greek-city-states, confidence 2) and Pella returns to Macedon (confidence 1: neither page says what became of Pella). Central Macedonia is no longer drawn (it holds Pieria and Imathia, the Macedonian heartland). Left to the macedonian-empire dossier: the 385 transfer, the 391 return and the 379 return of Pella are not in its ledger. The League page's date for the second transfer is arithmetic ('eight years later'), not a year. Not drawn: Potidaea, lost to Athens (undated) and handed back by Philip in 356 (Olynthian War page).
